description: A night scene of a grand neoclassical building with several domes, outlined in warm glowing lights and lit by searchlight beams against a black sky. A dark water channel in the foreground holds small boats and a gondola, with golden reflections on the water. At the lower left and right, people in 19th-century dress (top hats, long gowns, parasols) stand on a quay. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text, border or frame.
